versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεύς Εἰ ταῦτα οὕτως ἔχει;

controles.web: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
controles.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
controles.livre: E disse o chefe dos sacerdotes: Essas coisas são assim mesmo ?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἔφη Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοὶ καὶ πατέρες, ἀκούσατε. Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς δόξης ὤφθη τῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν Ἀβραὰμ ὄντι ἐν τῇ Μεσοποταμίᾳ πρὶν ἢ κατοικῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐν Χαρράν,

controles.web: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
controles.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
controles.livre: E ele disse: Homens irmãos e pais, ouvi: o Deus da glória apareceu a nosso pai Abraão, estando ele na Mesopotâmia, antes de habitar em Harã;

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς γῆς σου καὶ τῆς συγγενείας σου, καὶ δεῦρο εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἄν σοι δείξω.

controles.web: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land, and from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
controles.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Sai de tua terra, e de tua parentela, e vem a terra que eu te mostrarei.

versos.grego: τότε ἐξελθὼν ἐκ γῆς Χαλδαίων κατῴκησεν ἐν Χαρράν. κἀκεῖθεν μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ μετῴκισεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς νῦν κατοικεῖτε,

controles.web: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land, where you are now living.
controles.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
controles.livre: Então ele saiu da terra dos caldeus, e habitou em Harã. E dali, depois que morreu seu pai, ele partiu para esta terra, em que agora vós habitais.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κληρονομίαν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ βῆμα ποδός, καὶ ἐπηγγείλατο δοῦναι αὐτῷ εἰς κατάσχεσιν αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτόν, οὐκ ὄντος αὐτῷ τέκνου.

controles.web: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when he still had no child.
controles.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
controles.livre: E Deus não lhe deu herança nela, nem mesmo a pegada de um pé; mas prometeu que a daria a ele em propriedade, e a sua semente depois dele, não tendo ele filho ainda .

versos.grego: ἐλάλησεν δὲ οὕτως ὁ Θεὸς, ὅτι ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ πάροικον ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ, καὶ δουλώσουσιν αὐτὸ καὶ κακώσουσιν ἔτη τετρακόσια·

controles.web: God spoke in this way: that his seed would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
controles.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
controles.livre: E Deus falou assim: Tua semente será peregrina em terra alheia, e a escravizarão, e a maltratarão por quatrocentos anos.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸ ἔθνος ᾧ ἐὰν δουλεύσουσιν κρινῶ ἐγώ, ὁ Θεὸς εἶπεν, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσονται καὶ λατρεύσουσίν μοι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ.

controles.web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that will they come out, and serve me in this place.’
controles.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
controles.livre: E à nação a quem eles servirem, eu a julgarei, (disse Deus). E depois disso eles sairão, e me servirão neste lugar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ διαθήκην περιτομῆς· καὶ οὕτως ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ, καὶ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακώβ, καὶ Ἰακὼβ τοὺς δώδεκα πατριάρχας.

controles.web: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
controles.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
controles.livre: E ele lhe deu o pacto da circuncisão; e assim gerou a Isaque, e o circuncidou ao oitavo dia; e Isaque gerou a Jacó, e Jacó aos doze patriarcas.

versos.grego: Καὶ οἱ πατριάρχαι ζηλώσαντες τὸν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπέδοντο εἰς Αἴγυπτον· καὶ ἦν ὁ Θεὸς μετ’ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
controles.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
controles.livre: E os patriarcas, tendo inveja de José, venderam -no ao Egito; mas Deus era com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ χάριν καὶ σοφίαν ἐναντίον Φαραὼ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου, καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον καὶ ὅλον τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
controles.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
controles.livre: E o livrou de todas as suas aflições, e lhe deu graça e sabedoria diante de Faraó, rei do Egito; e o pôs por governador sobre o Egito, e toda a sua casa.

versos.grego: ἦλθεν δὲ λιμὸς ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν Αἴγυπτον καὶ Χανάαν καὶ θλῖψις μεγάλη, καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον χορτάσματα οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν.

controles.web: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
controles.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
controles.livre: E veio fome sobre toda a terra do Egito e de Canaã, e grande aflição; e nossos pais não achavam alimentos.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ Ἰακὼβ ὄντα σιτία εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν πρῶτον·

controles.web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
controles.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
controles.livre: Mas Jacó, ao ouvir que havia cereal no Egito, ele enviou nossos pais a primeira vez.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐγνωρίσθη Ἰωσὴφ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ, καὶ φανερὸν ἐγένετο τῷ Φαραὼ τὸ γένος Ἰωσήφ.

controles.web: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s race was revealed to Pharaoh.
controles.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
controles.livre: E na segunda vez ,José foi reconhecido pelos seus irmãos, e a família de José foi conhecia por Faraó.

versos.grego: ἀποστείλας δὲ Ἰωσὴφ μετεκαλέσατο Ἰακὼβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν ἐν ψυχαῖς ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε.

controles.web: Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
controles.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
controles.livre: E José mandou chamar a seu pai Jacó, e toda a sua parentela, setenta e cinco almas.

versos.grego: καὶ κατέβη Ἰακὼβ εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν,

controles.web: Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died, himself and our fathers,
controles.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
controles.livre: E Jacó desceu ao Egito, e morreu; ele, e nossos pais;

versos.grego: καὶ μετετέθησαν εἰς Συχὲμ καὶ ἐτέθησαν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ ὠνήσατο Ἀβραὰμ τιμῆς ἀργυρίου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐμμὼρ ἐν Συχέμ.

controles.web: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
controles.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
controles.livre: E foram levados a Siquém, e postos na sepultura que Abraão, por uma quantia em dinheiro, tinha comprado dos filhos de Emor em Siquém.

versos.grego: Καθὼς δὲ ἤγγιζεν ὁ χρόνος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἧς ὡμολόγησεν ὁ Θεὸς τῷ Ἀβραάμ, ηὔξησεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἐπληθύνθη ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ,

controles.web: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
controles.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
controles.livre: Mas quando chegou perto o tempo da promessa que Deus tinha prometido a Abraão, o povo cresceu e se multiplicou no Egito.

versos.grego: ἄχρι οὗ ἀνέστη βασιλεὺς ἕτερος ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον, ὃς οὐκ ᾔδει τὸν Ἰωσήφ.

controles.web: until there arose a different king, who didn’t know Joseph.
controles.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
controles.livre: Até que se levantou outro rei, que não tinha conhecido a José.

versos.grego: οὗτος κατασοφισάμενος τὸ γένος ἡμῶν ἐκάκωσεν τοὺς πατέρας τοῦ ποιεῖν τὰ βρέφη ἔκθετα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ μὴ ζωογονεῖσθαι.

controles.web: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
controles.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
controles.livre: Este, usando de astúcia para com nossa parentela, maltratou a nossos pais, até fazendo com que eles rejeitassem suas crianças, para que não sobrevivessem.

versos.grego: Ἐν ᾧ καιρῷ ἐγεννήθη Μωϋσῆς, καὶ ἦν ἀστεῖος τῷ Θεῷ· ὃς ἀνετράφη μῆνας τρεῖς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός·

controles.web: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
controles.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
controles.livre: Naquele tempo nasceu Moisés, e ele era muito formoso para Deus, e ele foi criado por três meses na casa de seu pai.

versos.grego: ἐκτεθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀνείλατο αὐτὸν ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραὼ καὶ ἀνεθρέψατο αὐτὸν ἑαυτῇ εἰς υἱόν.

controles.web: When he was thrown out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and reared him as her own son.
controles.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
controles.livre: E tendo sido abandonado, a filha de Faraó o tomou, e o criou para si como filho.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπαιδεύθη Μωϋσῆς πάσῃ σοφίᾳ Αἰγυπτίων, ἦν δὲ δυνατὸς ἐν λόγοις καὶ ἔργοις αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
controles.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
controles.livre: E Moisés foi instruído em toda a sabedoria dos egípcios; e era poderoso em palavras e ações.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦτο αὐτῷ τεσσερακονταέτης χρόνος, ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπισκέψασθαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E quando lhe foi completado o tempo de quarenta anos de idade , veio ao seu coração o desejo de visitar a seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδών τινα ἀδικούμενον ἠμύνατο, καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκδίκησιν τῷ καταπονουμένῳ πατάξας τὸν Αἰγύπτιον.

controles.web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
controles.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
controles.livre: E vendo um deles sofrendo injustamente, defendeu -o ,e vingou pelo que tinha sido oprimido, matando ao egípcio.

versos.grego: ἐνόμιζεν δὲ συνιέναι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς διὰ χειρὸς αὐτοῦ δίδωσιν σωτηρίαν αὐτοῖς· οἱ δὲ οὐ συνῆκαν.

controles.web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
controles.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
controles.livre: E ele pensava que seus irmãos tivessem entendido que Deus ia lhes dar liberdade por meio da mão dele; mas eles não entenderam.

versos.grego: τῇ τε ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς μαχομένοις, καὶ συνήλλασσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς εἰρήνην εἰπών Ἄνδρες, ἀδελφοί ἐστε· ἵνα τί ἀδικεῖτε ἀλλήλους;

controles.web: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
controles.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
controles.livre: E no dia seguinte, estando uns deles lutando, ele foi visto por eles, e ordenou-lhes fazerem as pazes, dizendo: Homens, vós sois irmãos, por que fazeis mal um ao outro?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀδικῶν τὸν πλησίον ἀπώσατο αὐτὸν εἰπών Τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστὴν ἐφ’ ἡμῶν;

controles.web: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
controles.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
controles.livre: Mas aquele que maltratava a seu próximo empurrou-o, dizendo: Quem te pôs por chefe e juiz sobre nós?

versos.grego: μὴ ἀνελεῖν με σὺ θέλεις ὃν τρόπον ἀνεῖλες ἐχθὲς τὸν Αἰγύπτιον;

controles.web: Do you want to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
controles.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
controles.livre: Queres tu também matar a mim, assim como ontem mataste ao egípcio?

versos.grego: ἔφυγεν δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ, καὶ ἐγένετο πάροικος ἐν γῇ Μαδιάμ, οὗ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς δύο.

controles.web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
controles.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
controles.livre: E com esta palavra Moisés fugiu, e foi peregrino na terra de Midiã, onde ele gerou dois filhos.

versos.grego: Καὶ πληρωθέντων ἐτῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ ὄρους Σινᾶ ἄγγελος ἐν φλογὶ πυρὸς βάτου.

controles.web: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
controles.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
controles.livre: E completados quarenta anos, um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu no deserto do monte Sinai, em uma sarça inflamada.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἰδὼν ἐθαύμαζεν τὸ ὅραμα· προσερχομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ κατανοῆσαι ἐγένετο φωνὴ Κυρίου

controles.web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,
controles.kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
controles.livre: Moisés, ao ver isso ,maravilhou-se da visão; e ao aproximar-se para ver, veio até ele a voz do Senhor,

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου, ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ. ἔντρομος δὲ γενόμενος Μωϋσῆς οὐκ ἐτόλμα κατανοῆσαι.

controles.web: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled, and dared not look.
controles.kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
controles.livre: Dizendo : Eu sou o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés, estando tremendo, não ousava olhar com atenção.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος Λῦσον τὸ ὑπόδημα τῶν ποδῶν σου· ὁ γὰρ τόπος ἐφ’ ᾧ ἕστηκας γῆ ἁγία ἐστίν.

controles.web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take your sandals off of your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
controles.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
controles.livre: E o Senhor lhe disse: Descalça-te as sandálias de teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν εἶδον τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, καὶ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἤκουσα, καὶ κατέβην ἐξελέσθαι αὐτούς· καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε εἰς Αἴγυπτον.

controles.web: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
controles.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
controles.livre: Eu tenho visto com atenção a aflição de meu povo que está no Egito, e ouvi o gemido deles, e eu desci para livrá-los; então vem agora, eu te enviarei ao Egito.

versos.grego: Τοῦτον τὸν Μωϋσῆν, ὃν ἠρνήσαντο εἰπόντες Τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστήν; τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς καὶ ἄρχοντα καὶ λυτρωτὴν ἀπέσταλκεν σὺν χειρὶ ἀγγέλου τοῦ ὀφθέντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ βάτῳ.

controles.web: “This Moses, whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
controles.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
controles.livre: A este Moisés, ao qual tinham negado, dizendo: Quem te pôs por chefe e juiz, A este Deus enviou por chefe e libertador, pela mão do anjo que lhe apareceu na sarça.

versos.grego: οὗτος ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ποιήσας τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν Ἐρυθρᾷ Θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα.

controles.web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
controles.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
controles.livre: Este os levou para fora, fazendo milagres e sinais na terra do Egito, e no mar Vermelho, e no deserto, por quarenta anos.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Μωϋσῆς ὁ εἴπας τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ Προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ.

controles.web: This is that Moses, who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
controles.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
controles.livre: Este é o Moisés que disse aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor, vosso Deus, vos levantará um profeta dentre vossos irmãos, como a mim; a ele ouvireis.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ γενόμενος ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινᾶ καὶ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ὃς ἐδέξατο λόγια ζῶντα δοῦναι ὑμῖν,

controles.web: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living oracles to give to us,
controles.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
controles.livre: Este é aquele que esteve na congregação do povo no deserto com o anjo que tinha lhe falado no monte Sinai, e com nossos pais; o qual recebeu as palavras vivas, para dar a nós;

versos.grego: ᾧ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ὑπήκοοι γενέσθαι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐστράφησαν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν εἰς Αἴγυπτον,

controles.web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
controles.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
controles.livre: Ao qual nossos pais não quiseram obedecer; mas o rejeitaram, e seus corações voltaram ao Egito;

versos.grego: εἰπόντες τῷ Ἀαρών Ποίησον ἡμῖν θεοὺς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν· ὁ γὰρ Μωϋσῆς οὗτος, ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί ἐγένετο αὐτῷ.

controles.web: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses, who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
controles.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
controles.livre: Ao dizerem a Arão: Faz-nos deuses, que irão adiante de nós; porque quanto a este Moisés, que nos levou para fora da terra do Egito, nós não sabemos o que aconteceu com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμοσχοποίησαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἀνήγαγον θυσίαν τῷ εἰδώλῳ, καὶ εὐφραίνοντο ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
controles.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
controles.livre: E naqueles dias eles fizeram o bezerro, o ofereceram sacrifício ao ídolo, e se alegraram nas obras de suas próprias mãos.

versos.grego: ἔστρεψεν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς λατρεύειν τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ τῶν προφητῶν Μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οἶκος Ἰσραήλ,

controles.web: But God turned, and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets,  ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
controles.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
controles.livre: E Deus se virou contra eles ,e os entregou, para que servissem ao exército do céu, assim como está escrito no livro dos profetas: Por acaso, casa de Israel, vós oferecestes a mim animais mortos, e sacrifícios no deserto por quarenta anos?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ Ῥομφά, τοὺς τύπους οὓς ἐποιήσατε προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς; καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Βαβυλῶνος.

controles.web: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship. I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
controles.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
controles.livre: Mas tomastes para si a tenda de Moloque, e a estrela de vosso Deus Renfã, figuras que vós fizeste para adorá-las; e eu por isso vos expulsarei para além da Babilônia.

versos.grego: Ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἦν τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθὼς διετάξατο ὁ λαλῶν τῷ Μωϋσῇ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸν τύπον ὃν ἑωράκει·

controles.web: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
controles.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
controles.livre: No deserto estava entre nossos pais o Tabernáculo do testemunho, assim como ele tinha ordenado, falando a Moisés, que o fizesse segundo o modelo que tinha visto.

versos.grego: ἣν καὶ εἰσήγαγον διαδεξάμενοι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ κατασχέσει τῶν ἐθνῶν, ὧν ἐξῶσεν ὁ Θεὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἕως τῶν ἡμερῶν Δαυείδ·

controles.web: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,
controles.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
controles.livre: O qual, recebendo -o também nossos Pais, eles levaram com Josué para a possessão dos gentios que Deus expulsou diante de nossos Pais, até os dias de Davi;

versos.grego: ὃς εὗρεν χάριν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ᾐτήσατο εὑρεῖν σκήνωμα τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰακώβ.

controles.web: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
controles.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
controles.livre: O qual foi do agrado diante de Deus, e pediu para achar um tabernáculo para o Deus de Jacó.

versos.grego: Σολομῶν δὲ οἰκοδόμησεν αὐτῷ οἶκον.

controles.web: But Solomon built him a house.
controles.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.
controles.livre: E Salomão lhe construiu uma casa.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὁ Ὕψιστος ἐν χειροποιήτοις κατοικεῖ· καθὼς ὁ προφήτης λέγει

controles.web: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
controles.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
controles.livre: Mas o Altíssimo não habita em templos feitos por mãos, assim como o profeta diz:

versos.grego: Ὁ οὐρανός μοι θρόνος, ἡ δὲ γῆ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν μου· ποῖον οἶκον οἰκοδομήσετέ μοι, λέγει Κύριος, ἢ τίς τόπος τῆς καταπαύσεώς μου;

controles.web: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord; ‘or what is the place of my rest?
controles.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
controles.livre: O céu é o meu trono, e a terra é o estrado dos meus pés; que casa vós construireis para mim?, diz o Senhor; ou Qual é o lugar do meu repouso?

versos.grego: οὐχὶ ἡ χείρ μου ἐποίησεν ταῦτα πάντα;

controles.web: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
controles.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
controles.livre: Por acaso não foi minhão mão que fez todas estas coisas?

versos.grego: Σκληροτράχηλοι καὶ ἀπερίτμητοι καρδίαις καὶ τοῖς ὠσίν, ὑμεῖς ἀεὶ τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ ἀντιπίπτετε, ὡς οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ ὑμεῖς.

controles.web: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
controles.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
controles.livre: Vós, obstinados e incircuncisos de coração e de ouvidos! Vós sempre resistis ao Espírito Santo! Tal como vossos pais foram ,assim também sois vós!

versos.grego: τίνα τῶν προφητῶν οὐκ ἐδίωξαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν; καὶ ἀπέκτειναν τοὺς προκαταγγείλαντας περὶ τῆς ἐλεύσεως τοῦ Δικαίου οὗ νῦν ὑμεῖς προδόται καὶ φονεῖς ἐγένεσθε,

controles.web: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
controles.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
controles.livre: Qual dos profetas vossos pais não perseguiram? E eles mataram a todos os que anunciaram com antecedência a vinda do Justo, do qual agora vós tendes sido traidores e homicidas;

versos.grego: οἵτινες ἐλάβετε τὸν νόμον εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξατε.

controles.web: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
controles.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
controles.livre: Que recebestes a Lei por ordem de anjos, e não a guardastes.

versos.grego: Ἀκούοντες δὲ ταῦτα διεπρίοντο ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἔβρυχον τοὺς ὀδόντας ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
controles.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
controles.livre: Eles, ao ouvirem estas coisas, retalharam-se de raiva em seus corações, e rangiam os dentes contra ele.

versos.grego: ὑπάρχων δὲ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶδεν δόξαν Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
controles.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
controles.livre: Mas ele, estando cheio do Espírito Santo, olhando firmemente para o céu, viu à glória de Deus, e a Jesus, que estava à direita de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ θεωρῶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς διηνοιγμένους καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν ἑστῶτα τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
controles.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
controles.livre: E disse: Eis que vejo os céus abertos, e o Filho do homem, que está a direita de Deus!

versos.grego: κράξαντες δὲ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ συνέσχον τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν, καὶ ὥρμησαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπ’ αὐτόν,

controles.web: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.
controles.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
controles.livre: Mas eles, clamando com alta voz, taparam seus próprios ouvidos, e correram juntos contra ele;

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες ἔξω τῆς πόλεως ἐλιθοβόλουν. καὶ οἱ μάρτυρες ἀπέθεντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας νεανίου καλουμένου Σαύλου.

controles.web: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
controles.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
controles.livre: E, lançando -o fora da cidade, o apedrejaram; e as testemunhas puseram as roupas deles junto aos pés de um rapaz chamado Saulo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλιθοβόλουν τὸν Στέφανον, ἐπικαλούμενον καὶ λέγοντα Κύριε Ἰησοῦ, δέξαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου.

controles.web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
controles.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
controles.livre: E apedrejaram a Estêvão, que estava clamando e dizendo: Senhor Jesus, recebe o meu espírito.

versos.grego: θεὶς δὲ τὰ γόνατα ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Κύριε, μὴ στήσῃς αὐτοῖς ταύτην τὴν ἁμαρτίαν. καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐκοιμήθη.

controles.web: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
controles.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
controles.livre: E pondo-se de joelhos, clamou com alta voz: Senhor, não os culpes por este pecado.E tendo dito isto, morreu.
